author: Elijah Jero
name: BotEngine
description: Relays Discord messages from enabled channels to an Ollama-based Bot Engine HTTP server and posts the engine's replies. Supports per-channel enable/disable, pauses, cooldowns, user blocks, conversation reset, and basic stats. Requires a separately running Bot Engine server.
install_msg: BotEngine loaded. This cog talks to an external Bot Engine HTTP server. Set the URL with `[p]botengine setapi <url>`, then enable a channel with `[p]botengine enable`.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild channel settings, pause/cooldown state, and blocked user IDs. Message content is sent to the configured Bot Engine server when a channel is enabled.
